c-member-share.1.evidence: bob on /community/s/feature-requests/t/let-members-schedule-posts/ clicked Share (aria-expanded true) -> .jt-share-dropdown anchored directly above the button (x 341-527 vs button 435-527) with Copy link, Twitter / X, Facebook, LinkedIn.

c-member-share.2.evidence: Copy link -> navigator.clipboard.readText() returned the exact topic URL and the status toast 'Link copied' appeared (dropdown closes).

c-member-share.3.evidence: Each social item opened a new tab: x.com intent/tweet?url=<encoded topic URL>&text=Let+members+schedule+posts, facebook.com/sharer?u=<topic URL>, linkedin shareArticle?url=<encoded topic URL> (X and LinkedIn bounce through their login redirect which keeps the encoded intent).

c-member-share.4.evidence: Dropdown closed on click outside (1200,300) and on mouse-wheel scroll of 200px.

c-member-share.5.evidence: Escape closed it; aria-expanded false and document.activeElement is the .jt-share-btn.

c-member-share.6.evidence: Guest on the public topic: same four items, Copy link puts the URL on the clipboard and shows 'Link copied'.

c-member-share.7.evidence: bob on a Partner Program topic: same dropdown, link is the private URL; as guest that URL returns 404 'Page not available' with no topic text, so Share never exposes the body.

c-member-share.8.evidence: GET /oembed?url=<public topic> as guest -> 200 with title and author_name; Partner Program topic -> 404 jetonomy_oembed_not_found; Moderators' Room (hidden) topic -> 404 jetonomy_oembed_not_found.

c-member-share.10.evidence: 390px, html dir=rtl (Arabic): dropdown rect left 8 right 195 top 429 bottom 580 inside 390x844 viewport; the button is 70x40.
